visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair, styled with a heart-shaped clip and a pearl necklace, wears a white spaghetti-strap dress with a blue floral pattern. She is adjusting her hair behind her head, her face showing dramatic shock with wide eyes and an open mouth against a blurred beige background. (2) The camera remains static as she stands behind a white table with several stacked black jewelry boxes. She gestures animatedly and speaks toward someone off-camera, transitioning from surprise to a more conversational and energetic demeanor. (3) The woman begins unboxing the accessories one by one. She holds up black frames containing yellow heart-shaped earrings, followed by a close-up shot of the product on her ear. Graphic overlays show prices and product names in Chinese text. (4) She continues showcasing various items, including butterfly ribbon earrings with dangling tassels, a silver ring set with star motifs, and unique cloud-shaped earrings with lightning-shaped drops. Each item is shown first in its box and then modeled on her body. (5) The final phase shows a montage of all the jewelry pieces—rings, earrings, and the cloud charms—arranged as graphical icons around the main character as she concludes her presentation with a celebratory gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched female exclamation starts the track, followed by rapid Mandarin speech with high emotional arousal. An upbeat electronic pop background track with a prominent synth bass and sharp percussion begins immediately. (2) A softer male voice responds from the background, creating a short conversational gap. The sound of sliding jewelry boxes creates distinct plastic friction noises. (3) The female voice transitions into a detailed product review, maintaining a high pitch and excited tone. Short, bright digital SFX like 'dings' and 'pops' are used to accentuate product reveals. (4) The audio concludes with a final enthusiastic call-to-action/goodbye from the female speaker, with the background music reaching a rhythmic peak before a sharp cut to silence.
